original.target_description: Verified matching Staniland and Byrne (2013) full-text accepted manuscript. Study examines adolescent boys, three conditions, three time points, and knowledge (AKQ), attitudes (ACL), and behavioural intentions (SAQ). Supplied locator p. 8 and the description do not specify a unique outcome, comparison, time contrast, or test. The manuscript has pagination different from the published article. Multiple main effects, interactions, and follow-up tests are reported; no single test selected.

replication.target_description: Published Ranson and Byrne (2014) article; female school students assigned to intervention, no-intervention peer and no-intervention non-peer conditions. Page 10 principally reports behavioural intentions (SAQ-R), including a condition-by-time interaction, two main effects, post-test/follow-up comparisons and within-condition changes. The locator does not uniquely select a test.

notes:
Blind extraction. No effect assignment inferred from input order. Original full text was acquired from the University of Wollongong institutional repository via Figshare and its title verified. Original is available; unresolved issue is test identification, not paper availability. Generic recruited sample was not treated as analytic n. Replication acquisition failure recorded in texts/aa4d2598f34ea5adf20855eb.miss. Authors' narrative replication verdict not extracted from abstract-only access.
Source follow-up: Fresh blind replication-only validation. Published article version, DOI/title/authors match supplied reference. PDF p. 10 visually inspected. Page locator narrows the outcome to behavioural intentions, but the neutral description covers all three outcomes and supplies no test, contrast, time point or condition. Page 10 contains mixed-model interaction and main effects, between-condition comparisons, within-condition repeated-measures tests, and several paired t tests; selecting one would require an unsupported assumption. The page also begins with the continuation of the attitude interpretation. No statistic assigned to this audit_id because the supplied locator cannot uniquely distinguish these tests. Generic recruitment and condition totals do not establish analytic n for a uniquely identified test. Canonical text renders less-than signs as backslashes and eta-squared as gp2; rendered PDF confirms conventional mathematical symbols. No quote normalization or metric conversion performed. Original is an unassigned placeholder, not a finding that its paper is unavailable.
